verdict.rationale: cubic documents an Analytics API, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. A plain API description page is not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for, and a SaaS review platform could plausibly ship one, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
